tasks.descricao: peer_service.go — malha ZeroMQ ROUTER/DEALER em PEER_PORT + WriteMessage/RouteMessage/ReadMessage
tasks.commit: feat(sida-core): malha ZeroMQ ROUTER/DEALER + primitivas InterEdge [T1B.3]
tasks.nota: peer_service.go: full-mesh — ROUTER bind em tcp://0.0.0.0:PEER_PORT (identity=CONTROLLER_ID) + 1 DEALER (identity=CONTROLLER_ID) por par; 1 goroutine (run) dono de todos os sockets, poller 100ms + drain do outbox. Frames [type,body]: MSG (Envelope JSON), PROBE/PROBE_ACK. WriteMessage(dst) -> Envelope{Path:[dst]} -> DEALER; route() = RouteMessage (Path[0]==self -> MessageBuffer por remetente; senao encaminha); ReadMessage() drena o buffer. probeLoop minimo (PROBE por par no ProbeInterval; markAlive no ACK). peer_handler.go: GET /api/system/peers + hooks POST /peers/test/send e GET /peers/test/inbox atras de PEER_MESH_TEST=1. main.go sobe/encerra o peer_service (:5556 intacto). compose.test.yml x-core-env += PEER_MESH_TEST=1. Checkpoint verde (2 passed, 47s): troca de payload integro edge_001<->edge_002 pela malha; ROUTER :5557 e PUB :5556 coexistem. Build+vet CGO ok.

tasks.descricao: probe loop + FSM alive/suspect/down (monotonico) + GET /api/system/peers
tasks.commit: feat(sida-core): probe loop, FSM de liveness e GET /api/system/peers [T1B.4]
tasks.nota: probeLoop reavalia a FSM a cada tick: missed = (time.Since(lastAck) - interval/2)/interval (folga p/ jitter); missed 0 -> alive, 1..N-1 -> suspect, >=PEER_DOWN_AFTER_MISSES -> down; sem ack ainda -> down. markAlive tanto no PROBE quanto no PROBE_ACK. /api/system/peers ja servido pelo Snapshot (id, endpoint, state, last_ack_ms, missed). CORRIGIDO: par que cai fazia o libzmq travar a thread de I/O num getaddrinfo ~5s (DNS do host morto), congelando TODA a malha -> resolvePeerEndpoint (LookupHost em Go, 2s) troca host por IP antes do Connect; init() SetIoThreads(4); sendVia usa SendMessageDontwait (nao bloqueia em par offline); run() drena outbox + RecvMessage(DONTWAIT) por ciclo; SndHwm(16)+Linger(0). Checkpoint verde (2 passed): frota 3 nos, stop edge_002 -> edge_001/edge_003 marcam edge_002 down em <=6s (missed 3, last_ack~4.8s) e seguem alive entre si (queda local).
